title: Governance-Aware XAI Cybersecurity — Reproducibility Artifact
description: Reproducibility artifact for the published article Governance-Aware Explainable AI for Cybersecurity Threat Detection and Risk-Based Response. The repository contains the public preprocessing, leakage-aware split, calibrated machine-learning, confidence-interval, cross-validation, SHAP, per-label evaluation, and illustrative risk-priority workflow together with immutable reported-run outputs.
